findings.expected: The dependent storyboard joins the same save as needs_review while old immutable snapshot stays intact.
findings.actual: The cue and translation require review; its dependent storyboard remains confirmed.

findings.given: A material confirmation preview starts at revision0 with one replacement ID.
findings.when: Controlled direct-API input mutation changes project revision/name and replacement ID array while hashing yields.
findings.expected: Capture the original revision/content/material inputs before the first await.
findings.actual: Plan silently adopts revision9, later name, and the added replacement ID.
findings.measurementLimit: Direct API await boundary; not a normal user mutation of React props.

findings.given: Source approval or dialogue copy preview starts from original revision0/content.

findings.expected: Use the original base and immutable content, then require reconfirmation for later changes.
findings.actual: Approval base becomes9; dialogue plan combines changed live original and copy derived from old text.
findings.measurementLimit: Direct API await boundary; not physical device evidence.
